description:
Error Storm Detector — WARN0302

Groups error log entries by a template fingerprint (strips numbers and quoted strings) then fires when any template appears >= storm-threshold times within storm-window-mins minutes.

config_keys.label: Storm occurrence threshold
config_keys.help: Number of occurrences of the same error template within the window to fire.

config_keys.label: Storm window (minutes)
config_keys.help: Rolling time window for counting error occurrences.
